title: A New Way to Solve a Murder, Part 1: The Genetic Detectives

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的现场对话。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行现场直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A year after police used a genetic database to crack the case of the Golden State Killer, the same technique has been used to arrest nearly 40 other people.
sentences.zh: 在警方使用基因数据库破获金州杀手案的一年后，同一技术已被用于逮捕近40名其他人。

sentences.en: Now, for the first time, one of those cases is headed to trial.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些案件中首次有一个即将进入审判阶段。

sentences.en: In part one of a two-part series, the story behind the tool that is transforming law enforcement and testing the limits of privacy.
sentences.zh: 在分两部分的系列报道的第一部分中，我们将探究这个正在改变执法力度并测试隐私极限的工具背后的故事。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月6日，星期四。

sentences.en: Heather, where does the story begin?
sentences.zh: 希瑟，这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So, the story begins with this guy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，故事是从这个人开始的。

sentences.en: It's Kurt Rogers.
sentences.zh: 他是库尔特·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: Hi, Kurt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，库尔特。

sentences.en: Kurt Rogers.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: It's Heather.
sentences.zh: 我是希瑟。

sentences.en: Hi, Heather.
sentences.zh: 嗨，希瑟。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: And Kurt Rogers is an entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·罗杰斯是一位企业家。

sentences.en: He spends his life in a lot of different kinds of businesses.
sentences.zh: 他的一生涉足许多不同类型的生意。

sentences.en: At one point, he runs a series of candy shops with his father in Florida.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他和父亲在佛罗里达州经营一系列糖果店。

sentences.en: Heather Murphy has been covering DNA technology for the Times.
sentences.zh: 希瑟·墨菲一直为《时报》报道DNA技术。

sentences.en: For a long time, he worked in trying to develop markets for Hellman's mayonnaise products in Asia.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，他致力于为好乐门美乃滋产品在亚洲开发市场。

sentences.en: For one thing, we wanted to introduce mayonnaise into Japan.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们希望将美乃滋引入日本。

sentences.en: They were not familiar with mayonnaise, so they was trying to figure out how it would fit into their eating habits.
sentences.zh: 他们对美乃滋并不熟悉，所以他试图弄清楚它将如何融入他们的饮食习惯。

sentences.en: And what ends up happening, though, is he gets interested in genealogy, like a lot of people do as they get older.
sentences.zh: 不过最终发生的是，就像许多人随着年龄增长所做的那样，他对家谱产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: Throughout my life, I've been working on this as a hobby.
sentences.zh: 在我的一生中，我一直把这当作一种爱好来做。

sentences.en: And back then, there was this site, and actually still is this site, Family Tree DNA.
sentences.zh: 而在当时，有这样一个网站，实际上现在仍然是这个网站，叫做 Family Tree DNA。

sentences.en: And somebody said, ah, you should join this project for people with the last name Rogers.
sentences.zh: 有人说，啊，你应该加入这个为姓氏是罗杰斯的人开设的项目。

sentences.en: And it helped people with the last name Rogers figure out how they were related.
sentences.zh: 它帮助姓罗杰斯的人弄清楚他们是如何产生亲缘关系的。

sentences.en: So he did, and he got really into it.
sentences.zh: 于是他照做了，并且真正迷上了它。

sentences.en: He was so into it, actually.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他太入迷了。

sentences.en: Well, I was asked to manage the Rogers group for one of the testing companies, Family Tree DNA.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有人邀请我为其中一家测试公司 Family Tree DNA 管理罗杰斯小组。

sentences.en: But pretty soon, he became the administrator for the Rogers project.
sentences.zh: 但不久之后，他成为了罗杰斯项目的管理员。

sentences.en: And so what that really means is he's just trying to help his fellow Rogers connect.
sentences.zh: 所以这真正意味着他只是在试图帮助同姓罗杰斯的人建立联系。

sentences.en: And he's doing a pretty good job at it, but he's getting frustrated because...
sentences.zh: 他在这方面做得相当不错，但他开始感到沮丧，因为……

sentences.en: They offered kind of a cookie-cutter type of a website.
sentences.zh: 他们提供的是那种千篇一律的网站。

sentences.en: It's all just a little bit clunky.
sentences.zh: 一切都显得有点笨拙。

sentences.en: And I wanted something more interactive.
sentences.zh: 而我想要一些更具互动性的东西。

sentences.en: And so he asked his network of Rogers, does anybody know a guy?
sentences.zh: 于是他问他的罗杰斯人脉网络，有没有人认识这方面的人才？

sentences.en: So I found a person who is very technically oriented, which I am not.
sentences.zh: 所以我找到了一个技术导向很强的人，而我并不是这样的人。

sentences.en: And yes, one of the Rogers knows a guy.
sentences.zh: 是的，其中一个罗杰斯确实认识这样一个人。

sentences.en: And was able to talk him into making a few algorithms for me, so we have a much more interactive site.
sentences.zh: 并且成功说服他为我编写了一些算法，所以我们拥有了一个互动性强得多的网站。

sentences.en: And then we're getting to around 2010, and he's hearing that people are starting to do DNA testing with sites like Ancestry.com and 23andMe.
sentences.zh: 接着时间到了2010年前后，他听说人们开始使用 Ancestry.com 和 23andMe 这样的网站进行 DNA 测试。

sentences.en: These companies could test people, and then they could match the people they've tested with other people they've tested.
sentences.zh: 这些公司可以对人们进行测试，然后将他们测试过的人与他们测试过的其他人进行匹配。

sentences.en: But there was no way for them to match with people who'd been tested by other companies.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法与被其他公司测试过的人进行匹配。

sentences.en: The problem with these other sites is that you have to pay to join them, and then they analyze your DNA.
sentences.zh: 这些其他网站的问题在于，你必须付费加入，然后他们会分析你的DNA。

sentences.en: And once they do that, you can only find relatives who also tested with and paid to join those sites.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们这样做了，你只能找到同样在该网站进行测试并付费加入的亲戚。

sentences.en: So he sees this opportunity to create a site where no matter who you tested with, no matter who you paid to join previously,
sentences.zh: 因此他看到了这样一个机会：创建一个网站，无论你是通过谁进行测试的，无论你以前付过费加入谁，

sentences.en: you can take those files that those sites created, upload them for free, and find relatives who've tested with all kinds of companies.
sentences.zh: 你都可以带上这些网站创建的文件，免费上传它们，并找到那些在各类公司进行过测试的亲戚。

sentences.en: And he also sees this opportunity to help people find and understand not just how they're related to second cousins, but way more distant relatives.
sentences.zh: 他还看到了一个机会，不仅能帮助人们找到并理解他们与表亲的关系，还能理解与更疏远的亲戚的关系。

sentences.en: And so he asked this programmer, who's now his business partner, to make this.
sentences.zh: 于是他请这位程序员（现在是他的商业合伙人）来制作这个网站。

sentences.en: And he did it.
sentences.zh: 他做到了。

sentences.en: Anyone who had been tested by any company could put their information on our site if they wished to do so,
sentences.zh: 任何在任何公司接受过测试的人，如果愿意的话，都可以将他们的信息放在我们的网站上，

sentences.en: and then find matches with people who had been tested with other companies.
sentences.zh: 然后与在其他公司接受过测试的人进行匹配。

sentences.en: And it was such a great program, I said, this is really too good for just my little Roger surname group.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常棒的程序，我说，这对于我这个小小的罗杰斯姓氏群来说实在是太好了。

sentences.en: Let's start another website and share this with other people.
sentences.zh: 让我们创办另一个网站，与其他人分享这个成果。

sentences.en: And so that's how their website began.
sentences.zh: 他们的网站就是这样开始的。

sentences.en: And how do I say GEDmatch?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么读 GEDmatch 这个词？

sentences.en: Yeah, you said it absolutely correctly.
sentences.zh: 是的，你读得完全正确。

sentences.en: It is GEDmatch.
sentences.zh: 就是 GEDmatch。

sentences.en: Kurt calls it GEDmatch.
sentences.zh: 库尔特称之为 GEDmatch。

sentences.en: His partner calls it GEDmatch.
sentences.zh: 他的合伙人称之为 GEDmatch。

sentences.en: So for people who are looking for relatives, it's a free place where they can go to find many more potential matches, no matter who the people on that site tested with.
sentences.zh: 所以对于寻找亲戚的人来说，这是一个免费的地方，他们可以在这里找到更多潜在的匹配对象，无论该网站上的人是通过谁测试的。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And GEDmatch just takes off.
sentences.zh: GEDmatch 就这样腾飞了。

sentences.en: Kurt told me that he was expecting, okay, maybe 10% growth.
sentences.zh: 库尔特告诉我，他原本期望的增长率，好吧，也许是10%。

sentences.en: That would be good based on working in something like the mayonnaise business.
sentences.zh: 考虑到曾在美乃滋之类的事业中工作过，那已经很不错了。

sentences.en: But he is far exceeding that.
sentences.zh: 但他远远超出了这个预期。

sentences.en: The number of uploads are doubling every year, and that's without any kind of advertising.
sentences.zh: 上传量每年都在翻倍，而且这还是在没有任何广告的情况下实现的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And they're growing and growing and growing so fast that at some point they crash the server.
sentences.zh: 他们的发展速度越来越快，以至于在某个时候把服务器都搞崩溃了。

sentences.en: Basically, too many people are using it.
sentences.zh: 基本上，有太多人在使用了。

sentences.en: Too many people are using it.
sentences.zh: 太多人在使用了。

sentences.en: They're getting so many emails that Kurt's wife is really angry with him because all he's doing is responding to emails all day.
sentences.zh: 他们收到了太多的电子邮件，以至于库尔特的妻子对非常生他的气，因为他整天都在回复电子邮件。

sentences.en: One of them, let me just say, the first one I ever did that was meaningful was a woman who didn't know her father because her mother had done a test tube baby.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个，请允许我直说，我经手过的第一个有意义的案例是一个不知道自己父亲是谁的女人，因为她的母亲是通过试管婴儿生下她的。

sentences.en: And so she finally found her father, and she got up the courage and called him, and she said who she was.
sentences.zh: 所以她终于找到了她的父亲，她鼓起勇气给他打了电话，并报上了自己的名字。

sentences.en: There was a big hesitation on the other side.
sentences.zh: 电话那头陷入了长时间的犹豫。

sentences.en: And the father then said, this is the happiest day of my life.
sentences.zh: 然后父亲说，这是我生命中最快乐的一天。

sentences.en: Today is my birthday, and there is no greater gift than this one.
sentences.zh: 今天是我的生日，没有什么比这更好的礼物了。

sentences.en: But aside from these letters, Kurt really had no idea how people were using his site across the country.
sentences.zh: 但除了这些信件之外，库尔特实际上并不知道人们是如何在全国各地使用他的网站的。

sentences.en: How were people using his site across the country?
sentences.zh: 人们是如何在全国各地使用他的网站的？

sentences.en: Well, fast forward to 2015.
sentences.zh: 嗯，时间快进到2015年。

sentences.en: There's an investigator named Deputy Pete Headley.
sentences.zh: 有一位名叫皮特·海德利副警长的调查员。

sentences.en: Headley here.
sentences.zh: 这里是海德利。

sentences.en: Can I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

sentences.en: And he's working on a case.
sentences.zh: 他正在负责一个案件。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I can.
sentences.zh: 听得到。

sentences.en: About a woman named Lisa.
sentences.zh: 关于一个名叫莉萨的女人。

sentences.en: It begins when this woman is just five years old.
sentences.zh: 故事始于这个女人只有五岁的时候。

sentences.en: This is the late 80s.
sentences.zh: 那是80年代末。

sentences.en: She's living in a trailer park in California with her father, and he's not taking very good care of her.
sentences.zh: 她和父亲住在加利福尼亚的一个拖车公园里，父亲并没有把她照顾得很好。

sentences.en: There was a couple there, an older couple, that befriended them.
sentences.zh: 那里有一对夫妇，一对年长的夫妇，和他们交上了朋友。

sentences.en: And the neighbors start to notice.
sentences.zh: 邻居们开始注意到这一点。

sentences.en: They knew something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们知道有些不对劲。

sentences.en: You know, living in the back of a camper shell like that, they heard Lisa crying at night sometimes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，住在那样一个露营车的后座里，他们有时会听到莉萨在夜里哭泣。

sentences.en: And they're talking to him, and they say, oh, she's such a sweet girl.
sentences.zh: 他们和他说话，然后他们说，哦，她是个多么可爱的女孩啊。

sentences.en: You know, we're happy to help out with her sometimes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们很乐意有时帮着照顾她。

sentences.en: They told him that their daughter was having a hard time having kids, and she'd like to adopt.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他，他们的女儿很难生育，她想收养一个孩子。

sentences.en: And so they take her.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把她带走了。

sentences.en: For what starts as a few weeks, it's this sort of trial adoption.
sentences.zh: 起初只是几个星期，这是一种试用性的收养。

sentences.en: Obviously, this is a pretty unconventional situation.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是一个非常非常规的情况。

sentences.en: And during the course of those few weeks, they start to notice that it's even worse than they thought.
sentences.zh: 在那几个星期里，他们开始注意到情况比他们想象的还要糟糕。

sentences.en: She's clearly been sexually abused.
sentences.zh: 她显然受到了性虐待。

sentences.en: And during this time, he disappears.
sentences.zh: 就在这段时间里，他消失了。

sentences.en: They don't know where he went.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道他去了哪里。

sentences.en: So they go to the local sheriff's department and say, what should we do?
sentences.zh: 于是他们去当地的警长办公室说，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: And the sheriff puts out a warrant for his arrest, both for child abandonment and for abuse.
sentences.zh: 警长对他的逮捕发出了通缉令，罪名是遗弃儿童和虐待。

sentences.en: The little girl ends up in foster care.
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩最终进入了寄养系统。

sentences.en: And eventually, they find him and arrest him.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们找到了他并将其逮捕。

sentences.en: He was in jail for about a year and a half.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里待了一年半左右。

sentences.en: When he was released, he immediately absconded parole, and his location was unknown again until...
sentences.zh: 他一获释就立刻违反了假释规定，行踪再次成谜，直到……

sentences.en: And then quite a few years later...
sentences.zh: 而在好几年之后……

sentences.en: He was arrested in 2002 in Contra Costa County.
sentences.zh: 他在2002年在康特拉科斯塔县被捕。

sentences.en: He's arrested again, this time for murder.
sentences.zh: 他再次被捕，这一次是因为谋杀罪。

sentences.en: And when they arrested him, they ran his fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 当他们逮捕他时，他们核对了他的指纹。

sentences.en: And it came back with all these other AKAs.
sentences.zh: 结果显示出了所有这些其他的别名。

sentences.en: So you had a list of different identities.
sentences.zh: 所以你有一张不同身份的名单。

sentences.en: Like, how many identities were talking for him?
sentences.zh: 比方说，我们谈论的是他的多少个身份？

sentences.en: Um, let me see.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我想想。

sentences.en: We have Robert Evans, Curtis Kimball, Gordon Curtis Jensen, Harold Mockerman, Lawrence Vanner,
sentences.zh: 我们有罗伯特·埃文斯、柯蒂斯·金博尔、戈登·柯蒂斯·詹森、哈罗德·莫克曼、劳伦斯·范纳，

sentences.en: Hulus Jensen, and different variations on the names.
sentences.zh: 胡卢斯·詹森，以及这些名字的不同变体。

sentences.en: And they saw his previous criminal history involving Lisa.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了他以前涉及莉萨的犯罪记录。

sentences.en: And they obtained DNA from him at that time and compared it to Lisa.
sentences.zh: 他们当时从他身上获取了 DNA 并将其与莉萨进行了比对。

sentences.en: And at that point, everyone realized, he's not related at all.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，所有人都意识到，他根本没有亲缘关系。

sentences.en: Where did he get this kid?
sentences.zh: 他从哪里弄来这个孩子的？

sentences.en: That's when we went back and reopened the case to try to determine who she really was and where he took her from.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我们回过头来重新立案调查，以确定她到底是谁，以及他是从哪里把她带走的。

sentences.en: So that little girl, whose neighbors were concerned about her dad, and that dad got arrested, and she goes into foster care, this test is showing he's not actually her dad.
sentences.zh: 所以那个小女孩，她的邻居曾为她的父亲担心，而那个父亲被捕了，她进入了寄养系统，这个测试显示他实际上并不是她的父亲。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this woman grew up thinking that she was abandoned by her abusive father.
sentences.zh: 所以这个女人在成长过程中一直以为自己被虐待她的父亲抛弃了。

sentences.en: Now as an adult, she's learning, actually, her abusive father was not her father.
sentences.zh: 现在作为成年人，她得知实际上那个虐待她的父亲并不是她的父亲。

sentences.en: He was her kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 他是她的绑架者。

sentences.en: Well, we know this suspect kidnapped her.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道这个嫌疑人绑架了她。

sentences.en: And she has no idea who she is.
sentences.zh: 而她根本不知道自己是谁。

sentences.en: But we don't know who she is.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道她是谁。

sentences.en: So we're trying to determine who she is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正试图确定她是谁。

sentences.en: So Deputy Pete Headley, he's one of these traditional cold case detectives who never give up.
sentences.zh: 所以皮特·海德利副警长，他是那种永不放弃的传统陈年旧案侦探之一。

sentences.en: I just kept hitting dead ends.
sentences.zh: 我只是不断地碰壁。

sentences.en: And it was really frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这真的很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: But, you know, I had promised Lisa that I wouldn't give up.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我曾向莉萨保证我不会放弃。

sentences.en: They just keep working and working and working and working a case.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不断地、不断地、不断地、不断地调查一个案件。

sentences.en: And so I just kept trying to think of any possible way that we could identify her.

sentences.en: So Detective Pete Headley is hitting dead end after dead end in the Lisa case.

sentences.en: What does he do?
sentences.zh: 他会怎么做？

sentences.en: So by 2015, he starts to hear that adoptees are finding their biological parents through these genealogy sites.
sentences.zh: 所以在2015年左右，他开始听说被收养者通过这些族谱网站找到了他们的亲生父母。

sentences.en: And he thinks, wait, actually, couldn't that help us?
sentences.zh: 他想，等等，这其实不是能帮到我们吗？

sentences.en: So he reaches out to an organization that's known for this type of thing.
sentences.zh: 于是他联系了一个以做这种事情而闻名的组织。

sentences.en: I just sent an email to DNAadoption.com asking them if the same methods that they use to find adoptees biofamilies could be used to identify Lisa.
sentences.zh: 我给 DNAadoption.com 发了一封电子邮件，询问他们用来寻找被收养者亲生家庭的方法是否也可以用来确定丽莎的身份。

sentences.en: Barbara Rae Venter responded to my email.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·雷·文特回复了我的邮件。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm going to take the headphones off one second.

sentences.en: I need to take my earrings off.

sentences.en: And who is Barbara Rae Venter?
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·雷·文特是谁？

sentences.en: Barbara Rae Venter is a very interesting character.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·雷·文特是一个非常有趣的人物。

sentences.en: I arrived in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我来到美国是在

sentences.en: in December 68.
She's originally from New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 她原本来自新西兰。

sentences.en: I applied to the University of Texas Law School and I was accepted.
sentences.zh: 我申请了德克萨斯大学法学院并被录取了。

sentences.en: She spent a lot of her life as a patent attorney and she worked on all kinds of interesting biotech innovations.
sentences.zh: 她的大部分时间都是作为专利律师度过的，她研究了各种有趣的生物技术创新。

sentences.en: Anything from new organisms for making better strains of penicillin.
sentences.zh: 从培育更好的青霉素菌株的新生物体。

sentences.en: Including the first genetically modified fruit.
sentences.zh: 包括第一种转基因水果。

sentences.en: To the flavor saver tomato.
sentences.zh: 到延熟保鲜西红柿。

sentences.en: The flavor saver tomato for a company that later became part of Monsanto.
sentences.zh: 为一家后来成为孟山都一部分的公司研发的延熟保鲜西红柿。

sentences.en: Did you ever find yourself having to defend your employer to your friends?
sentences.zh: 你有没有发现自己不得不向朋友们辩护你的雇主？

sentences.en: I didn't make a big point of mentioning that I did genetically modified food and other things.
sentences.zh: 我没有大肆宣扬我做过转基因食品和其他东西。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: As she got older in life, she got interested in genealogy as many people do.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄的增长，她和许多人一样对家谱学产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: And she volunteered with an organization called DNA Adoption where she helped adoptees to find their biological parents.
sentences.zh: 她在名为“DNA收养”的组织做志愿者，在那里她帮助被收养者寻找他们的亲生父母。

sentences.en: And she was really good at it.
sentences.zh: 而且她在这方面非常擅长。

sentences.en: For me, of course, I understand all the science.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，当然，我懂所有的科学原理。

sentences.en: I don't need tutorials on that.
sentences.zh: 我不需要这方面的教程。

sentences.en: So for me,
sentences.zh: 所以对我而言，

sentences.en: it was probably a little easier than for most people because all I'm trying to learn is how to actually use the DNA in conjunction with research techniques for traditional family history research.
sentences.zh: 这可能比大多数人要容易一些，因为我所要学习的只是如何将DNA与传统族谱研究的研究技术结合起来实际使用。

sentences.en: And then one day, she gets a message from Deputy P.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，她收到了P.海德利

sentences.en: Hedley.
sentences.zh: 警官的信息。

sentences.en: I was working on my computer on something and the email came in.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在电脑上处理一些事情，邮件就发来了。

sentences.en: And to me, it was an intriguing question.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一个耐人寻味的问题。

sentences.en: Could we, in fact, identify somebody who had no clue who she was when all we really would have is her DNA?
sentences.zh: 我们是否真的可以确定这样一个人的身份：当她完全不知道自己是谁，而我们真正拥有的只有她的DNA时？

sentences.en: We didn't know anything else about her.
sentences.zh: 我们对她一无所知。

sentences.en: That's when Barbara Rae Venter responded back and said yes.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，芭芭拉·雷·文特回复说可以。

sentences.en: But because we had no geographic information on her, it was going to be difficult.
sentences.zh: 但因为我们没有她的地理信息，这将会很困难。

sentences.en: So how does she go about finding this woman's parents?
sentences.zh: 那么她是怎么着手寻找这个女人的父母的呢？

sentences.en: I mainly worked through Deputy Hedley, but I did have conversations with Lisa at various times.
sentences.zh: 我主要通过海德利警官工作，但我确实在不同时间与丽莎有过对话。

sentences.en: She's a very charming, very sweet person, but she also is obviously wanting to very much maintain her privacy.
sentences.zh: 她是一个非常迷人、非常甜美的人，但显然她也极力想要保持隐私。

sentences.en: So what she needs to do is she needs to find some relatives, hopefully close relatives.
sentences.zh: 所以她需要做的是找到一些亲戚，最好是近亲。

sentences.en: Theoretically, the technique that we were using for finding both relatives should work for somebody like Lisa.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们用来寻找双方亲属的技术应该适用于像丽莎这样的人。

sentences.en: And so I had Lisa test at Ancestry, 23andMe, and family tree DNA.
sentences.zh: 所以我让丽莎在 Ancestry、23andMe 和 family tree DNA 做了测试。

sentences.en: And also upload to GEDmatch.
sentences.zh: 并且也上传到了 GEDmatch。

sentences.en: Kurt's site, GEDmatch, is an essential tool for her.
sentences.zh: 库尔特的网站 GEDmatch 对她来说是一个必不可少的工具。

sentences.en: And all the matches that showed up there, Barbara would build a tree up from these people that are related to her until the trees cross and you get to Ancestry and Common.
sentences.zh: 对于在那儿显示的所有匹配项，芭芭拉会从这些与她有亲缘关系的人开始往上建立家谱，直到家谱交叉，找到共同祖先。

sentences.en: I hope that it's somebody relatively close, like a great-grandparent or a great-great-grandparent.
sentences.zh: 我希望这是一个相对较近的人，比如曾祖父母或高祖父母。

sentences.en: And at that point, I then search for all of the descendants of that common ancestor.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，我接着搜索那个共同祖先的所有后代。

sentences.en: So then she can say, your victim is a descendant of this ancestor in common.
sentences.zh: 这样她就可以说，你的受害者是这个共同祖先的后代。

sentences.en: And then as she followed the trees back down to the living folk, I would use all of our law enforcement resources to find those living people and contact them.
sentences.zh: 然后，当她顺着家谱向下追踪到健在的人时，我会利用我们所有的执法资源来找到那些还活着的人并联系他们。

sentences.en: Like, what kind of resources?
sentences.zh: 比如，什么样的资源？

sentences.en: Everything from DMV records to old census records.
sentences.zh: 从机动车管理局（DMV）记录到旧的人口普查记录，应有尽有。

sentences.en: But at this point, my primary job with Barbara was to find the living folk and call them up and start asking them to do a DNA teSt.
sentences.zh: 但在这一点上，我和芭芭拉的主要工作是找到还活着的人，给他们打电话，并开始要求他们做DNA测试。

sentences.en: And that's how you narrow it in.
sentences.zh: 这就是你缩小范围的方法。

sentences.en: As the amount of matching DNA increases,
sentences.zh: 随着匹配DNA数量的增加，

sentences.en: you know that you're getting closer to the correct family descendants.
sentences.zh: 你知道你离正确的家族后代越来越近了。

sentences.en: And what did you say when you contacted them?
sentences.zh: 当你联系他们时，你说了什么？

sentences.en: It was difficult, making cold calls like that.
sentences.zh: 这很难，进行这种突击电话拜访。

sentences.en: I would always start off with,
sentences.zh: 我通常会以这句话开头：

sentences.en: I'm working on a cold case and I'm hoping you can help me out.
sentences.zh: 我正在处理一个陈年旧案，希望你能帮个忙。

sentences.en: Some people, they would just hang up.
sentences.zh: 有些人直接就挂断了电话。

sentences.en: A lot of people thought it was a scam.
sentences.zh: 很多人以为这是个骗局。

sentences.en: I had one woman that thought I was going to try to clone her.
sentences.zh: 我曾遇到过一个女人，以为我要尝试克隆她。

sentences.en: So this goes on for many months.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了好几个月。

sentences.en: Barbara estimates at the end that it takes 20,000 hours of work from about 100 volunteers, many of whom are distant relations of Lisa's.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉最后估计，这需要大约100名志愿者进行2万小时的工作，其中许多人是丽莎的远亲。

sentences.en: The maternal line tree in particular was enormous.
sentences.zh: 特别是母系族谱非常庞大。

sentences.en: It had something like 18,000 people in it.
sentences.zh: 里面大概有18000人。

sentences.en: So eventually, they narrow Lisa's father down to one of five brothers who seemed to live in New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，他们将丽莎的父亲范围缩小到似乎住在新罕布什尔州的五兄弟之一。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, all of the brothers were married when Lisa was conceived.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，当丽莎受孕时，这些兄弟都已婚。

sentences.en: And so they're not really happy to hear that they might have this other child.
sentences.zh: 所以他们其实并不高兴听到自己可能还有另一个孩子。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they don't want to be tested, which is not helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不想接受测试，这毫无帮助。

sentences.en: On the other side of Lisa's family, though, on her mother's side, Barbara and her team have more luck.
sentences.zh: 不过，在丽莎家族的另一边，也就是她母亲那边，芭芭拉和她的团队运气更好。

sentences.en: They eventually find this person who, based on looking at the family tree, appears likely to be Lisa's grandfather.
sentences.zh: 他们最终找到了这个人，根据家谱来看，他很可能是丽莎的外祖父。

sentences.en: That's a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 这是一个突破。

sentences.en: It's a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 这是一个突破。

sentences.en: He is also skeptical of all of this at first, but they eventually convince him it's legit and he agrees to be helpful, partly because another family member convinces him.
sentences.zh: 一开始他对这一切也持怀疑态度，但他们最终说服了他这是合法的，他同意提供帮助，部分原因是有另一个家庭成员说服了他。

sentences.en: And they do a DNA teSt.
sentences.zh: 他们做了DNA测试。

sentences.en: And what they find is it confirms that he is indeed Lisa's grandfather.
sentences.zh: 他们发现这证实了他确实是丽莎的外祖父。

sentences.en: And what her grandfather tells her is the last time he saw her, she was two.
sentences.zh: 她的外祖父告诉她，他最后一次见到她时，她两岁。

sentences.en: And her mother was involved with this guy.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲和这个家伙在一起。

sentences.en: And his name was Bob Evans.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫鲍勃·埃文斯。

sentences.en: Family didn't know a lot about him.
sentences.zh: 家人对他的了解不多。

sentences.en: At the time, he talked up that they owed money to a bunch of people, insinuated that it was to dangerous, bad people that they owed money to even.
sentences.zh: 当时，他吹嘘说他们欠了很多人钱，甚至暗示他们欠钱的对象是危险的、不好惹的人。

sentences.en: But in the middle of the night, they absconded.
sentences.zh: 但在半夜，他们潜逃了。

sentences.en: And the family never heard from them again.
sentences.zh: 家人再也没有他们的消息。

sentences.en: And they just assumed that she'd just gone off with this guy.
sentences.zh: 他们只以为她跟着这个家伙走了。

sentences.en: They didn't know what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: That's when I contacted Manchester Police Department and briefed them on the case, told them this is a missing person.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我联系了曼彻斯特警察局并向他们通报了案情，告诉他们这是一个失踪人口。

sentences.en: Denise Bowden moved away with this guy, Bob Evans, and she's actually a missing person.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝·鲍登和这个名叫鲍勃·埃文斯的家伙搬走了，她其实是一个失踪人员。

sentences.en: So what did you tell Lisa?
sentences.zh: 那你对丽莎说了什么？

sentences.en: When I called her up, I told her that we had been able to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 当我给她打电话时，我告诉她我们已经弄清楚了。

sentences.en: And she got very quiet.
sentences.zh: 她变得非常安静。

sentences.en: And then I asked her if she'd like to know her name.
sentences.zh: 然后我问她是否想知道自己的名字。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么后来呢？

sentences.en: I told her her name is Dawn Bowden.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她她的名字叫道恩·鲍登。

sentences.en: And then she called me a couple days later, had had some time to think about it, and was wondering, well, should she change her date of birth, change her name?
sentences.zh: 然后她过几天给我打了电话，经过了一些思考，想知道她是否应该改出生日期，改名字？

sentences.en: It had to be a big shock.
sentences.zh: 这一定是个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: And I just told her, that's something for you to think about and decide on.
sentences.zh: 我只是告诉她，那是你需要去思考和决定的事情。

sentences.en: It was very emotional being able to actually do that for her,
sentences.zh: 能够真正为她做到这一点，是非常情绪化的，

sentences.en: particularly knowing what had happened to her.
sentences.zh: 特别是知道了她身上发生的事情之后。

sentences.en: And so it was very nice to be able to give her back her family and to give her her name.
sentences.zh: 所以能够把她的家人还给她，把她的名字还给她，感觉非常好。

sentences.en: It was very satisfying to be able to tell her who she is.
sentences.zh: 能够告诉她她是谁，让人感到非常满足。

sentences.en: It made it all worth it.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是值得的。

sentences.en: So what Deputy Pete Headley and other investigators believe is that sometime after he kidnapped Dawn, he killed her mom.
sentences.zh: 皮特·海德利警探和其他调查人员认为，在他绑架道恩后不久，他就杀害了她的母亲。

sentences.en: They have not found her body, but the reason they believe this is because this was part of a pattern of behavior.

sentences.en: It's believed that he killed at least two other women he was involved with and three children.
sentences.zh: 据信他还杀害了其他至少两名与他有染的女性和三个孩子。

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.zh: 但不是道恩。

sentences.en: But not Dawn.

sentences.en: So I just want to get this straight.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: the man who she thought was her father was actually a serial killer who kidnapped and likely murdered her mother.
sentences.zh: 她以为是自己父亲的那个男人，实际上是一个绑架并很可能谋杀了她母亲的连环杀手。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Lisa is Dawn.
sentences.zh: 丽莎就是道恩。

sentences.en: Lisa is Dawn.
sentences.zh: 丽莎就是道恩。

sentences.zh: 而芭芭拉用 GetMatch 做完了这一切。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this is a really big deal because it shows that you can use GetMatch and use family tree building techniques to identify much more than just an adoptee's parents.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一件大事，因为它表明你可以使用 GetMatch 并利用家谱构建技术来确定的不仅仅是被收养者的父母。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 最终还有另一位调查员。

sentences.en: He has no real leads.
sentences.zh: 他没有真正的线索。

sentences.zh: 警方终于通过梳理商业族谱网站，在金州杀手案中取得了突破。

sentences.zh: 至少12起谋杀案。

sentences.en: 45 rapes.
sentences.zh: 45起强奸案。

sentences.en: 45 rapes and more than 100 burglaries.
sentences.zh: 45起强奸案以及100多起入室盗窃案。

sentences.en: They have been searching for more than four decades.
sentences.zh: 他们已经寻找了四十多年。

sentences.en: And tonight the major clue.
sentences.zh: 而今晚，则是核心线索。

sentences.en: Investigators compared DNA found at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 调查人员比对了在犯罪现场发现的 DNA。

sentences.en: We found the needle in the haystack.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了大海捞针的那根针。

sentences.en: To genetic information listed on the websites which...
sentences.zh: 与网站上列出的遗传信息进行比对，这些网站...

sentences.en: He's been called the Eastside Rapist, the Visalia Ransacker, the original Night Stalker, and the Golden State Killer.
sentences.zh: 他曾被称为东区强奸犯、维萨利亚劫掠者、初代暗夜恶魔和金州杀手。

sentences.en: Today it's our pleasure to call him defendant.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很高兴称他为被告。

sentences.en: So all of this work from the Lisa case has led to this groundbreaking moment.
sentences.zh: 因此，莉萨案的所有这些工作促成了这个具有突破性的时刻。

sentences.en: This is the first time that we're seeing a public arrest in such a high-profile case.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次在如此备受瞩目的案件中看到公开逮捕。

sentences.en: A case of a serial killer that has eluded detectives for decades.
sentences.zh: 一个让侦探们几十年都束手无策的连环杀手案件。

sentences.en: And now they finally have a name.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他们终于知道了他的名字。

sentences.en: They finally have somebody behind bars.
sentences.zh: 他们终于把嫌疑人关进了铁窗。

sentences.en: And that is because they have used this technique that people are calling genetic genealogy.
sentences.zh: 这是因为他们使用了一种人们称之为基因系谱学的手法。

sentences.en: And that leads us back to the site that Kurt Rogers built.
sentences.zh: 这把我们带回了库尔特·罗杰斯建立的网站。

sentences.en: Genmatch.
sentences.zh: Genmatch。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's only after the announcement that the alleged Golden State Killer has been arrested,
sentences.zh: 就在宣布所谓的金州杀手落网之后，

sentences.en: Kurt told me, that he learned that his site had been pivotal to this investigation.
sentences.zh: 库尔特告诉我，他才得知自己的网站对这次调查起到了关键作用。

sentences.en: He had been asked previously if his site could be used by law enforcement to identify murderers and rapists.
sentences.zh: 此前曾有人问过他，执法部门是否可以使用他的网站来识别凶手和强奸犯。

sentences.en: And he'd actually said, no, he couldn't explicitly sanction it.
sentences.zh: 而他当时的回答是，不，他不能明确批准。

sentences.en: Because people were there primarily for genealogical research.
sentences.zh: 因为大家去那里主要是为了进行家谱研究。

sentences.en: No one was expecting to be cooperating with law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 没有人预料到会与执法部门合作。

sentences.en: My concerns were that there could be a violation of privacy.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是这可能会侵犯隐私。

sentences.en: I had to figure that out in my head if that was true or not.
sentences.zh: 我不得不在脑子里琢磨这到底是不是真的。

sentences.en: And what helped you figure it out?
sentences.zh: 是什么帮你想通的？

sentences.en: Time.
sentences.zh: 时间。

sentences.en: A lot of sleepless nights.
sentences.zh: 许多个失眠的夜晚。

sentences.en: But then he starts getting these emails and they are so congratulatory.
sentences.zh: 但随后他开始收到这些邮件，里面充满了祝贺。

sentences.en: They are telling him that he has done great things for the world and he is feeling incredibly proud of what he has created.
sentences.zh: 邮件里告诉他，他为世界做了伟大的事情，他为自己创造的成果感到无比自豪。

sentences.en: It's like when they first discovered that fingerprints could be used to identify individuals.
sentences.zh: 这就像当年人们首次发现指纹可以用来辨认个人身份一样。

sentences.en: We've now started a whole new field of forensics.
sentences.zh: 我们现在开启了一个全新的法医领域。

sentences.en: It's not as direct as fingerprints, don't get me wrong, but it's a whole new way of finding people.
sentences.zh: 别误会，它不像指纹那么直接，但这是寻找人们的全新方式。

sentences.en: So he and his partner decide to officially open up, get matched to law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 于是他和他的合伙人决定正式开放，让 Genmatch 配合执法部门。

sentences.en: To me, the real important thing was the people who've been victims, and that includes their families.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，真正重要的是受害者，这其中也包括他们的家人。

sentences.en: And bringing closure to them is extremely important to me.
sentences.zh: 给他们一个了结，对我来说至关重要。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And they rewrite the user agreement so that what it now says is that by default, users are opted in to allow their profiles to be searched by law enforcement
sentences.zh: 他们修改了用户协议，现在的规定是，默认情况下，用户同意允许执法部门搜索他们的个人资料，

sentences.en: for the purposes of sexual assault and murder cases.
sentences.zh: 目的仅限于性侵犯和谋杀案件。

sentences.en: I'd never realized how many families and people there are out there who have been suffering for decades
sentences.zh: 我以前从未意识到，有那么多家庭和人们，数十年来一直饱受折磨，

sentences.en: because of some violent crime that's happened in their family.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为他们家族发生过某种暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: And there must be millions, literally millions of people like that.
sentences.zh: 这样的人一定有数百万，真的有数百万之多。

sentences.en: And that changed everything.
sentences.zh: 而这改变了一切。

sentences.en: On the Daily, part two of the story.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《每日新闻》，本集故事的第二部分。

sentences.en: At the time of the Golden State Killer suspect arrest, a lot of people were opining that this was going to be a one-off, that it was too difficult, too much time investment, etc.
sentences.zh: 在金州杀手嫌疑人被捕时，许多人断言这只是一次性的事件，太困难、投入的时间太多等等。

sentences.en: And I wanted to prove that that wasn't true, that the power of genetic genealogy could absolutely be applied to cold cases and even active cases.
sentences.zh: 而我想证明这不是真的，基因系谱学的力量绝对可以应用于未破悬案甚至是正在调查的案件。

sentences.en: There was no reason that that couldn't happen.
sentences.zh: 没有任何理由认为这行不通。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, YouTube said it would remove thousands of videos and channels that advocate for bigoted ideologies like neo-Nazism and white supremacy
sentences.zh: 周三，YouTube 表示将删除数千个宣扬新纳粹主义和白人至上主义等偏执意识形态的视频和频道，

sentences.en: in the latest attempt by a major technology company to limit hate speech.
sentences.zh: 这是大型科技公司限制仇恨言论的最新举措。

sentences.en: YouTube, which is owned by Google, said its new policy would ban videos that justify discrimination by claiming a specific group is superior to others
sentences.zh: 归谷歌所有 YouTube 表示，其新政策将禁止那些声称某一群体优于其他群体来为歧视辩护的视频，

sentences.en: or that deny the existence of violent incidents, such as the Holocaust and the Sandy Hook school shooting.
sentences.zh: 或者否认大屠杀和桑迪胡克小学枪击案等暴力事件存在的视频。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration said it would drastically reduce federal spending on medical research that uses tissue from aborted fetuses,
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府表示，将大幅削减使用堕胎胎儿组织进行医学研究的联邦经费，

sentences.en: fulfilling a longtime goal of anti-abortion groups.
sentences.zh: 这实现了反堕胎组织长期以来的目标。

sentences.en: Scientists have long used fetal tissue to test drugs and vaccines, targeting everything from HIV to cancer, and say that, in many cases, there is no substitute.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直使用胎儿组织来测试药物和疫苗，涉及从艾滋病毒到癌症的各个领域，并表示在许多情况下，这是无可替代的。

sentences.en: But opponents, including Representative Steve Scalise, the number two Republican in the House of Representatives, called federal funding of such research
sentences.zh: 但包括众议院共和党二号人物、众议员史蒂夫·斯卡利斯在内的反对者称，此类研究的联邦资助

sentences.en: immoral.
sentences.zh: 是不道德的。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了（也译：将）一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入激烈、混乱、有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是主持人莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持自身影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
